root.label: Judge dismisses Reese's deceptive marketing case

events.label: Judge dismisses Reese's deceptive marketing case

slots.name: dismissal date
slots.sentence: Customers may have noticed the change after Florida District Judge Melissa Damian on Sept. 16 dismissed a case filed in May 2024, accusing Hershey of deceptive marketing for several Reese's Peanut Butter products, including Reese's Peanut Butter Pumpkins, according to court documents.
